title: Rabbi Sovayah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim, chapter 6, end of halakhah 1, Resh Lakish speaks in his name. Hyman proposes the reading as the statement is cited in Eruvin 10:12, where Resh Lakish speaks in the name of Levi Sivayah. He regards this as correct, as he finds in Yoma 8:6 that he spoke in his name, except that there the words “ben Lakish” are missing.

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim reads Rabbi Sovayah. The parallel in Eruvin has Levi Sovayah and differs in the wording of the teaching. The translation retains Hyman’s Sivayah form.
